integrity: The provided finite checker is a consistency test; universal claims rely on the written combinatorial derivations and a classical renewal theorem. Independently assessed scientific priority and proof have not been established.
scientific_limitations: Uniform fixed-alphabet words and ordinary labeled palindromes only; no uniform large-alphabet asymptotic. The palindrome-index lemma is known from Barker et al. (2020), Proposition 15; the claimed contribution is the complete enumerator, exact minimal counts and asymptotic distribution. Literary priority is subject to external confirmation.
title: Exact subsequence-universality distribution of palindromes
